description: Barwon Water Pressure Sewer Pipes is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Barwon Water. Barwon Water sewer assets feature layer details the location and attributes for current and decommissioned sewer fittings, gravity sewer pipes and pressure sewer pipes within the Barwon Water utility network. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Barwon Water. Its tags are Barwon Water, Open Data, decommissioned, fittings, gravity. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-03-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-nc-nd. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
